# netbox_available_prefix (Resource)

Allocates the next free prefix of the requested length from a parent prefix. Import with "<parent_prefix_id> <prefix_id> <prefix_length>".

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_prefix" "test" {
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

resource "netbox_available_prefix" "test" {
  parent_prefix_id = data.netbox_prefix.test.id
  prefix_length    = 25
  status           = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_prefix_id` (Number) The ID of the parent prefix associated with the available prefix.
- `prefix_length` (Number) The prefix length of the available prefix.
- `status` (String) Valid values are `active`, `container`, `reserved` and `deprecated`.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the available prefix.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the available prefix.
- `is_pool` (Boolean) Whether all addresses of the available prefix, including network and broadcast addresses, are usable.
- `location_id` (Number) The ID of the location associated with the available prefix. Conflicts with `site_id`, `site_group_id` and `region_id`.
- `mark_utilized` (Boolean) Whether the available prefix is treated as fully utilized.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the available prefix. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `region_id` (Number) The ID of the region associated with the available prefix. Conflicts with `location_id`, `site_id` and `site_group_id`.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the available prefix.
- `site_group_id` (Number) The ID of the site group associated with the available prefix. Conflicts with `location_id`, `site_id` and `region_id`.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the available prefix. Conflicts with `location_id`, `site_group_id` and `region_id`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the available prefix.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The ID of the vlan associated with the available prefix.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the vrf associated with the available prefix.

### Read-Only

- `children` (Number) The children of the available prefix.
- `created` (String) When the available prefix was created.
- `family` (String) The family of the available prefix.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the available prefix was last changed.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix in CIDR notation.
- `scope` (String) The scope of the available prefix.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is "<parent_prefix_id> <prefix_id> <prefix_length>"
terraform import netbox_available_prefix.example "1 2 28"
```
